zh.title: 2026年法恩堡航展閉幕交易額達847億美元
zh.summary: 2026年法恩堡國際航空展圓滿閉幕，共吸引逾14萬名訪客，並創造超過847億美元的商務交易額，促成353架民用飛機確認訂單。期間波音、空中巴士、巴西航空工業及普惠等大廠發表重大協議，Vertical Aerospace亦完成首場公開的eVTOL飛行展示。
body: 2026年法恩堡國際航空展（Farnborough International Airshow）已正式圓滿落幕。在這一週內，該展覽共創造了超過847億美元的商業交易額，並成功促成了353架民用飛機的確認訂單。主辦單位法恩堡國際（Farnborough International）表示，這場為期五天的盛大展覽匯聚了全球航太、國防、太空領域的企業、政府官員、投資者與學術界，共同展示了最新科技，並深入探討了航空產業的未來發展。
本屆航空展的參觀人數出現了極為顯著的增長，共迎來了來自136個國家的141,580名專業人士與公眾訪客。與上一屆航展的參觀人數相比，此數字大幅增長了41%，且幾乎是2022年航空展所錄得參觀人數的兩倍，充分展現出全球航太產業在後疫情時代的強勁復甦動能與商務交流需求。
各大航太製造商的商業訂單與發動機協議成為本週的核心焦點。在展會期間發表重大飛機與發動機聲明的企業包括波音、空中巴士、巴西航空工業、LEAP以及普惠。法恩堡航空展持續作為製造商、供應商與航空公司及租賃公司建立新協議與深化合作關係的重要平台。
先進空中交通（Advanced Air Mobility）的技術突破亦是展覽的一大亮點。Vertical Aerospace 在航展現場完成了其首次公開的電動垂直起降（eVTOL）飛行展示，在公眾面前示範了從直升機模式過渡到固定翼飛行、隨後再返回垂直飛行的關鍵過程。最後，主辦單位也宣布，下一屆法恩堡國際航空展將於2028年7月17日至21日重返漢普郡（Hampshire）的展覽會議中心舉行。

en.title: Farnborough Airshow 2026 Closes with $84.7 Billion in Deals and Surge in Attendance
en.summary: The 2026 Farnborough International Airshow concluded with over $84.7 billion in commercial business and 353 firm aircraft orders. Attracting 141,580 trade and public visitors from 136 countries, the event saw a 41% increase in attendance compared to the prior show. Major aerospace manufacturers including Boeing, Airbus, Embraer, and Pratt & Whitney announced key agreements, while Vertical Aerospace completed its first public electric vertical take-off and landing flight demonstration. The next airshow is planned for July 2028.
body: The 2026 Farnborough International Airshow has officially concluded after a record-breaking week, generating more than $84.7 billion in commercial business and securing 353 firm commercial aircraft orders. According to the organizers, Farnborough International, the five-day exhibition highlighted the resilience and growth of the global aerospace sector by bringing together key industry players, defense firms, space representatives, government officials, investors, and academic institutions to showcase new technology and announce major commercial deals.

The event recorded a significant surge in attendance, welcoming 141,580 trade and public visitors from 136 countries. This overall attendance total represents a substantial 41% increase compared to the previous edition of the airshow, and is nearly double the visitor numbers recorded during the 2022 event, demonstrating a strong international interest and recovery in global aerospace activities.

Commercial announcements dominated the show, featuring major aircraft and engine deals from prominent global manufacturers. Among the leading participating companies making significant announcements during the week were Boeing, Airbus, Embraer, LEAP, and Pratt & Whitney. The event continues to serve as an essential venue for manufacturers and suppliers to secure new agreements and strengthen relationships with airline customers and leasing companies.

Innovation in advanced air mobility provided one of the standout moments during the exhibition, featuring the first public electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) demonstration flight by Vertical Aerospace. The flying display showcased a transition from helicopter mode to fixed-wing flight before returning to vertical flight. Finally, organizers confirmed that the next edition of the Farnborough International Airshow is scheduled to take place from July 17 to 21, 2028, at the Farnborough International Exhibition and Conference Centre.
